explanations.trigger_explanation: Development in the unincorporated Harris County floodplain commonly requires a floodplain development permit before work proceeds.

known_unknowns: Exact plan submittals vary by the type of development and whether the work is within or adjacent to a special flood hazard area.
advisories: Additional review recommended for substation pads, access roads, culverts, crossings, and fill in mapped floodplains.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the permit requirement is clearly published by Harris County, but implementation details vary by project type and floodplain setting.
